faq.q: How does Cekat.AI help hotels and hospitality businesses?
faq.a: It answers guest chats instantly 24/7 on WhatsApp, Instagram, and web chat, reservations, rates, facilities, check-in details, and event inquiries, while keeping every conversation organized in one inbox. Guests get instant answers at any hour, and your front desk isn't buried in repetitive questions.

faq.q: Can the AI handle reservations and bookings?
faq.a: Yes. The agent answers availability and rate questions and captures booking details in the conversation. Through API integration it connects to your systems, and complex or high-value bookings route to your team with everything already gathered, so nothing stalls waiting for a manual reply.

faq.q: Can it handle event and group inquiries?
faq.a: Yes. Cekat.AI gathers event details, dates, headcount, package, budget, inside the chat and hands qualified inquiries to your team with the full context. Holywings Group used this to reach 100% chat coverage and up to +70% conversion on inquiries that used to be handled manually.

faq.q: What results have hospitality businesses seen?
faq.a: Holywings Group moved from handling event, booking, and pricing inquiries manually to 100% chat coverage 24/7 after implementing Cekat.AI, with up to +70% conversion, higher guest satisfaction, and more revenue from inquiries that previously went unanswered after hours.

faq.q: Which channels can a hotel or venue connect?
faq.a: WhatsApp (official Business API), Instagram DM, Facebook Messenger, and website live chat, all flowing into one unified inbox. Every guest keeps a single conversation history, so an inquiry that started on Instagram and continued on WhatsApp stays in one place.

faq.q: Does it work outside office hours?
faq.a: Yes. AI working hours let the agent cover chats around the clock, then hand back to your team during working hours with full context. Guests booking at midnight or comparing rates late at night get an instant answer instead of waiting until morning.

faq.q: Can I send promotions to past guests?
faq.a: Yes. Broadcast campaigns go through the official WhatsApp Business API to segments built from activity and stay history, past guests, event clients, lapsed bookings. Messages pull names and context from the CRM, so a weekday offer or seasonal package feels relevant instead of generic.

Building the AI agent takes around five minutes and works like briefing a new front-desk admin, you paste your rates, facilities, policies, and SOPs, and it starts answering. No coding is required, so you don't need a developer or a long IT project to launch.

faq.q: What happens with complaints or special requests?
faq.a: Complaints are labeled automatically, turned into a ticket, and routed to the right team with the full conversation attached, tracked from first message to resolution. Special requests and VIP conversations escalate to a human, so sensitive moments always get a personal touch.
